legal_note: Geographic indexing support for planning discovery, not legal advice or an activation permission matrix.
separation_rule: Prediction operators are never blended with the sportsbook competitor set, share-of-search series, state pressure scores or persona affinity.

operators.label: FanDuel Predicts
operators.regulatory_index: CFTC-regulated contracts delivered with CME Group; product availability differs by contract type.
operators.geographic_summary: Financial, economic and commodities contracts were reported in all 50 states. Sports contracts were reported in 18 non-sportsbook states, including California, Texas and Florida; the filing does not enumerate the other 15.
operators.sports_switch_rule: FanDuel says Predicts sports event contracts cease when a state legalizes online sports betting.

operators.label: Kalshi
operators.geographic_summary: Kalshi describes its event-contract exchange as available in all 50 states. State-level disputes and product-specific restrictions remain a review layer, not a reason to model sportsbook-style state market share.

operators.label: Polymarket US
operators.regulatory_index: QCX LLC d/b/a Polymarket US is listed by the CFTC as a Designated Contract Market from 2025.
operators.geographic_summary: The reviewed CFTC designation establishes the federal exchange status but does not publish a current product-by-state availability matrix. State cells therefore remain unenumerated rather than being assumed live.
operators.optional_future_feed: Live Polymarket market data can be added later as an optional wow; it must not be used to infer US state reach without a separate geographic receipt.
